inserts.narration: Let us make the preparation visible. In Demo Director, locate A2A Delegation. Select that named capability. Read the preparation review before confirming. This review restores the reported daylight anomaly and selects peer delegation. An open work order can explain the override; it does not repair it. The selected chip is a pending choice until confirmation. After applying it, check the stage and the readiness message, then return to Command Center.

lab12-02.narration: With the starting conditions prepared, let us follow the recorded run.
